info.title: kaneo-cli corrections to the Kaneo OpenAPI document
info.description: Written in JSON because oapi-codegen-dd v3.75.20 fails to apply a YAML overlay to a JSON document ('invalid character' while re-reading the result).

actions.description: better-auth's organization routes are documented with empty schemas, which generate as struct{} and decode to nothing. The server answers with the organization object. REMOVE WHEN the upstream document gives these responses a schema.
Part of the Organization correction above. REMOVE WHEN the upstream document gives the organization list a schema.
Part of the Organization correction above. REMOVE WHEN the upstream document gives the organization update a schema.
The generator turns an empty schema into struct{}, so a metadata value that is not an object (a string, a number) fails the whole board. REMOVE WHEN oapi-codegen-dd maps an empty schema to any.
Same generator fault as the metadata entry: eventData holds whatever the activity type carries. REMOVE WHEN oapi-codegen-dd maps an empty schema to any.

userId is required and null means unassign, but the generator tags a nullable field omitempty, so an unassign would send {} and be rejected. REMOVE WHEN oapi-codegen-dd leaves omitempty off required fields.
number and position are typed number, which generates float32 and rounds past 16,777,216. REMOVE WHEN the upstream document types them integer.
number and position are typed number, which generates float32 and rounds past 16,777,216. REMOVE WHEN the upstream document types them integer.
